FN-AR8VK7Q-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 54
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 54 as introduced would provide for the continuance of the Alabama Surface Mining
Commission until October 1, 2030 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The provisions of this
bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
